description: This file is a C header file defining exported API functions related to Content Filtering access keys within a larger system. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing components associated with access keys.

methods.name: ContFilterCreateAccessKey
methods.description: Creates and returns an access key handle for Content Filtering.

methods.name: ContFilterAkoCreate
methods.description: Creates the Content Filter Access Key (AKO) object.

methods.name: ContFilterAkoRemove
methods.description: Removes the AKO object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ContFilterAkoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the AKO context.
